subtitle: Out Manila · Xiamen Airlines
overview: This 9-day no-shopping tour flies Xiamen Airlines from Manila via Xiamen to Kunming. You visit the Stone Forest, Dali, Lijiang with Jade Dragon Snow Mountain, and Shangri-La with Songzanlin Monastery, then return by high-speed train to Kunming. You stay seven nights in 5-star hotels and one night in a 4-star hotel, with one meal upgraded to a seafood buffet.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 11–19 2026 to Jan 17–25 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Daguan Park: A lakeside park in Kunming beside Dianchi Lake with gardens, pavilions and a historic tower.
placeDesc.Haigeng Dam (seagull season): A Dianchi Lake dyke where red-billed gulls gather in winter; visited in season, subject to on-site conditions.
placeDesc.Jinbi Square: A central Kunming square with the Golden Horse and Jade Rooster archways nearby.
placeDesc.Stone Forest: A famous Kunming-area karst landscape of tall grey limestone pillars; a shuttle cart is included.
placeDesc.Yi People Ancient Town: A town in Chuxiong built to showcase Yi ethnic culture and architecture.
placeDesc.Santorini of Dali: A white-walled lakeside viewpoint by Erhai Lake in Dali that is popular for photos; afternoon tea is included.
placeDesc.Black Dragon Pool: A pond park in Lijiang with a view of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
placeDesc.Lijiang Ancient Town: A UNESCO World Heritage old town of canals, cobbled lanes and Naxi houses.
placeDesc.Sifang Street: The central square of Lijiang Ancient Town, a lively spot for evening strolls.
placeDesc.Jade Dragon Snow Mountain: A snow-capped mountain range above Lijiang; this tour visits the glacier park by ropeway.
placeDesc.Gan Haizi: A grassy meadow basin at the foot of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain.
placeDesc.Impression Lijiang: An outdoor live song and dance show with local ethnic performers, staged before the snow mountain.
placeDesc.Baishui River: A mountain stream with milky blue pools in the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain area.
placeDesc.Blue Moon Valley: A valley of blue-green pools and waterfalls in the Baishui River area; a battery car is included.
placeDesc.Jade Water Village: A Naxi village near Lijiang; on the Jan 2027 departure it includes Dongba culture activities.
placeDesc.Tiger Leaping Gorge: A deep gorge on the Jinsha River, visited on the way to Shangri-La with hand escalators included.
placeDesc.Napa Sea: A seasonal lake and grassland near Shangri-La; one complimentary coffee is included.
placeDesc.Dukezong Ancient City: The old Tibetan-style town centre of Shangri-La.
placeDesc.Guishan Park: A hilltop park in Shangri-La holding the world's largest prayer wheel.
placeDesc.Songzanlin Monastery: A large Tibetan Buddhist monastery near Shangri-La; a shuttle cart is included.
placeDesc.Dali Ancient City: A walled old town in Dali with traditional lanes and city gates; the electric cart is not included.
placeDesc.Foreigner Street: A pedestrian street in Dali with cafes, shops and restaurants.
placeDesc.Heilongtan Park: A lakeside park in Kunming known for seasonal flower viewing.
placeDesc.Kunming City Walk: A walk through Kunming's Jingxinghua Street, Qianwang Old Street and Nanping Pedestrian Street.
